thesis: October 6 results delivered $567 million quarterly sales, $1.00 non-GAAP EPS and a raised fiscal 2027 outlook. Today's 13.08% advance confirms interest, but the stronger full-year earnings base may still support several sessions of follow-through.

thesis: October 6 earnings exceeded company guidance and management raised full-year sales, adjusted EPS and EBITDA forecasts. Today's $48.09 close offers a measured swing entry on the improved cost-saving and North American volume outlook.
main_risk: Input and freight inflation or continued international weakness can erode the raised guidance; the post-report rally may stall.

thesis: Newly announced definitive Google agreements run through 2048 and include $1.8 billion of planned generation investment and projected $150 million net income in 2030. The contracted earnings opportunity could drive continued estimate revisions after today's 7.21% gain.
main_risk: The market may have fully capitalized earnings that arrive years later; financing, construction and higher rates can pressure valuation.

thesis: Nasdaq confirms Moderna enters the Nasdaq-100 before the October 9 open, creating a defined index-rebalance window over the next two sessions. Today's 4.81% rebound supports an attempt to capture incremental index-related demand, which remains an inference rather than a guaranteed flow.
main_risk: Index demand may already be priced in; a rapid reversal or post-inclusion selling can overwhelm mechanical buying.

thesis: Lisa Su's October 6 comments confirm plans for a substantial 2027 supply increase to meet AI demand and longer-term capacity planning. Today's modest 0.55% pullback permits a swing entry on that fresh demand signal without assuming a new customer contract.
main_risk: Supply planning is not booked revenue, and elevated expectations plus higher yields can compress the multiple.

thesis: Today's Nvidia-powered Surface launch and current Copilot expansion reinforce Microsoft's ability to distribute AI across its enterprise and Windows ecosystem. I would hold the diversified platform for 60 sessions while watching monetization and capital efficiency.
main_risk: AI spending may outrun monetization, and higher rates can compress the valuation despite product progress.

thesis: The October 6 Constellation agreement secures incremental power capacity and expands a Google Cloud and Gemini Enterprise technology alliance. That combination supports a 60-session thesis in scalable cloud and AI distribution, with power execution as a material constraint.
main_risk: Power comes online over years, while AI spending, competition and regulatory pressure can limit shareholder returns.

thesis: Today's fresh AWS review reports 36.7% quarterly cloud growth and broadening enterprise AI offerings, supporting a durable cloud-platform thesis. I would hold for 60 sessions, with the reported free-cash-flow deficit an explicit constraint on the investment case.
main_risk: Heavy infrastructure spending has pushed trailing free cash flow negative; permitting delays and weaker consumer demand can prolong that pressure.

thesis: The FDA's October 2 first-line Jaypirca approval expands an established oncology franchise, and today's 2.70% gain demonstrates relative strength. The 60-session thesis is that continued pipeline commercialization supports growth, while the stock still requires valuation discipline.
main_risk: Drug pricing pressure, trial setbacks or a valuation reset can overwhelm the incremental benefit of this label expansion.

thesis: The October 6 renewal of Visa's OpenTable agreement expands cardholder dining access across North America and illustrates the ongoing value of its payments network. I would hold for 60 sessions for recurring transaction economics rather than expect this partnership alone to cause a large daily move.
main_risk: A spending slowdown, payments competition or regulatory limits on network economics can reduce growth and valuation.
